what: Both models on Basalt 0.5.7 on one RTX 5090, each at the settings its publisher recommends, same harness and cases: 16 core cases with thinking off and on, three sampled runs; the 32-problem HumanEval subset, three runs in non-thinking mode; six focused reruns. Budget 16,384 tokens (HumanEval and focused 8,192). Inkling: a fresh single-slot server per run. Flash-Next: the service as it runs (four slots, shared 1,048,576-token context, int8 cache).

inkling_2_mini.settings: temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, top_k 0, min_p 0 (both modes; thinking off means the lowest effort)

flash_next.settings: thinking mode: temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, min_p 0, xhigh; non-thinking mode: temperature 0.7, top_p 0.80, top_k 20, min_p 0, presence penalty 1.5
